policy: Install once, route narrowly, and use current evidence. Bundled availability does not imply activation, safety, freshness, or stronger task-effectiveness evidence.
activation_contract: CS Navigator activates on capability-selection intent, not task subject matter alone.
Bundled skills must not self-activate from subject matter alone; explicit skill invocation or capability-selection intent is required.
Bundled skills remain independently evidenced and versioned.
A matching bundled skill is not necessary when ChatGPT can handle the direct task natively.
Freshness, permissions, security findings, execution evidence, and known gaps must remain separate.
Do not assume skill-to-skill handoff; recommend the capability and keep the next action explicit when needed.
